native_config:
model = "kimi-k3"
model_provider = "kimi"
model_context_window = 1048576

[model_providers.kimi]
name = "Kimi"
base_url = "https://api.moonshot.ai/v1"
env_key = "KIMI_API_KEY"
wire_api = "responses"
invocation: codex exec "<task>" from the task worktree
limitations: The block mirrors the Kimi vendor guide. Whether a Codex release accepts a non-OpenAI provider end to end was not run here.
Built-in provider IDs openai, ollama and lmstudio are reserved, so this uses a new ID `kimi`.
Sandbox and approval keys are omitted because they were not retrievable in this session. Set them before any real use.
In the ultimate profile Codex is allowed only as a conditional alternate on an HK-reachable model. The OpenAI provider is unavailable there.
The Moonshot international base URL is shown; confirm the endpoint your account is allowed to use from Hong Kong.
role_binding: Used for A05 alternate: one author seat in a sandbox. Reviewer stays a different harness and model family.

profiles.ultimate: Conditional alternate: kimi-k3 first rung via the custom provider above.
profiles.hybrid: Alternate may use an OpenAI route through the metered gateway only if that route is configured as a custom provider.
profiles.b4b: Same as hybrid, and cap placement still applies.
profiles.global: May use the built-in OpenAI provider with gpt-6.1-sol; no custom block needed.
